course.title: German A1 Level : For Beginners!
course.description: Learn German Language From A Native and Experienced German Teacher - Learn German Grammar, Vocabulary and Speaking from scratch.

faqs.q: Do I need any prior knowledge of German?
faqs.a: No. This course is designed for complete beginners starting from the German alphabet.

faqs.q: How long do I have access to the course?
faqs.a: You get lifetime access on mobile, tablet, and desktop.

faqs.q: Is this course suitable for Goethe A1 exam preparation?
faqs.a: Yes. The course includes preparation for the speaking and writing parts of the official A1 certification.
